cases.name: Function "CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#Page_Load" implements: Empty page lifecycle handler for calculator web form.

assertions.subject: CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#Page_Load
assertions.expected: Empty page lifecycle handler for calculator web form.
assertions.explanation: The handler is intentionally empty. Verify it does not alter any label text, viewstate, or input controls on either the first load (IsPostBack == false) or subsequent postbacks.

cases.name: Function "CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#btSomar_Click" implements: Adds two text input numbers and displays the sum result.

assertions.subject: CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#btSomar_Click
assertions.expected: Adds two text input numbers and displays the sum result.
assertions.explanation: Given numeric strings in both textboxes, the handler parses them (per current culture), adds them, and writes the sum to the result label. E.g. '2' + '3' yields '5'.

cases.name: Function "CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#btSubtrair_Click" implements: Subtracts two input numbers and displays result in label.

assertions.subject: CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#btSubtrair_Click
assertions.expected: Subtracts two input numbers and displays result in label.
assertions.explanation: The handler parses both inputs and writes their difference to the label in correct order (minuend - subtrahend). E.g. '5' - '3' yields '2'.

cases.name: Function "CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#btMultiplicar_Click" implements: Multiplies two text input numbers and displays result in label.

assertions.subject: CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#btMultiplicar_Click
assertions.expected: Multiplies two text input numbers and displays result in label.
assertions.explanation: The handler parses both inputs, multiplies them, and writes the product to the label. E.g. '4' * '3' yields '12'.

cases.name: Function "CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#btDividir_Click" implements: Divides two input numbers and displays result in label.

assertions.subject: CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#btDividir_Click
assertions.expected: Divides two input numbers and displays result in label.
assertions.explanation: The handler parses both inputs and writes the quotient to the label. Verify precision/type (integer vs floating-point division) matches the source, e.g. '7' / '2'.

cases.name: Function "CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#btPotencia_Click" implements: Computes power of two input numbers and displays result in label.

assertions.subject: CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#btPotencia_Click
assertions.expected: Computes power of two input numbers and displays result in label.
assertions.explanation: The handler parses both inputs, computes the power, and writes the result to the label. E.g. base '2', exponent '3' yields '8'.

cases.name: Function "CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#btRaizq_Click" implements: Compute square root of input number and display result.

assertions.subject: CalculadoraWebForms/index.aspx.cs#btRaizq_Click
assertions.expected: Compute square root of input number and display result.
assertions.explanation: The handler parses the single input and writes its square root to the label. E.g. '9' yields '3'.
